questions.answer: Yes, very much. I've been a keen reader since childhood. I mostly read non-fiction these days, especially business or self-improvement, since I enjoy the feeling of [[broadening]] my knowledge with each book.

questions.q: What kind of books do you enjoy?
questions.answer: I lean towards non-fiction, particularly psychology and personal growth. Occasionally I'll pick up a good novel to switch off, but generally I prefer something that offers a genuine [[insight]] or two.

questions.q: Do you prefer printed books or e-books?
questions.answer: Printed books, definitely. I love the feel of paper and being able to see my progress through the pages. That said, e-books are handy for travelling, so I can see myself [[embracing]] both eventually.

questions.q: What did you read as a child?
questions.answer: Mostly comics and adventure stories, which I borrowed from friends or bought with my pocket money. I remember being completely [[engrossed]] in them, often reading late into the night by torchlight.

questions.q: Do you think young people read less than they used to?
questions.answer: In terms of books, probably yes, as phones and social media compete for their attention. But they actually read a great deal online. The problem is that it's often [[fragmented]] content rather than anything in depth.
